data.one_liner: Dart extension methods for Iterable and List like sum, count, chunks, and sorting.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of extension methods for Iterables and Lists in Dart. It adds utility operations for searching, math (sum, min, max, avg), transformations (chunks, intersperse, mapping with index), and safe element access.
use_when: You need convenient extension methods for lists and iterables such as safe element access and math calculations.
You want to easily split lists into chunks or map elements with their indices.
avoid_when: You only need standard core Dart collection methods and want to minimize extra dependencies.
strengths: Extends standard collections with widely used utility methods.
Includes safe element access and null-safety support.
Provides math and transformation helpers directly on Iterables.
weaknesses: Relies on external packages like quiver and collection.
Adds methods to global Iterable and List types which might pollute namespace.
